results.content:
Mobbin uses a higher-priced subscription model:

The Free plan gives very limited access. You only see a few recent apps and flows, with heavy limits on search and downloads.

The Pro plan costs about $10 per month when billed yearly. It unlocks full access to apps, flows, animations, unlimited collections, and downloads. This plan is aimed at individual designers. [...] The Team plan costs about $12 per member per month when billed yearly. It adds team collections, comments, admin tools, and centralized billing. This plan is clearly built for companies.

Refero is more affordable:

The Free plan gives access to only a small part of the library, around a few percent, but it is enough to understand the product.

The Pro plan costs $8 per month when billed yearly. It unlocks full access to web and iOS screens, advanced search, and user flow grouping. [...] The Team plan costs $10 per month per seat when billed yearly. It adds collaborative bookmarks and shared access.

Refero wins on price. Mobbin costs more but delivers more depth.

### How much does Mobbin cost per month?

Mobbin pricing varies depending on your usage tier and the features you need. For individual users and small teams, SMB plans typically average around $504. Enterprise plans average around $4146 and add more features and higher usage limits. Custom pricing may be negotiated directly with Mobbin using SpendHound.

### What are Mobbin’s pricing plans and which one is right for my business? [...] Across the major UI/UX Design providers, list pricing for comparable capabilities is generally similar, but real differences emerge in performance per dollar for your specific use case. On average, Mobbin is priced at $504 and $4146 for SMB and Enterprise plans, respectively. Figma runs at an average of $10448 and $93847. Canva is priced at $2566 and $21249, on average. Webflow pricing averages out to $7793 AND $65821.

### What is Mobbin Enterprise pricing and what does it include? [...] Mobbin offers multiple pricing tiers to match different team sizes and use cases. At an average of $504 SMB plans are designed for small to mid-size teams who need core functionality. For larger organizations, Enterprise plans at an average of $4146 include enterprise-grade features and support. Pricing may be custom and based on headcount, usage volume, and contract length. Most businesses use a combination of tiers depending on team function.
